title: Daily Loan Interest Comparison Posters
problem: Daily wage workers take small ₹2,000 loans from local moneylenders, not realising that paying ₹100 interest every week eats away their food money.
idea: A calculator that turns 'small weekly interest' into a yearly interest rate, and compares it with a bank or self-help group loan.

widgets.heading: 🧮 Try it: How costly is this loan really?
widgets.intro: Type the loan and the weekly interest. Bank / SHG rates are only examples – check at your bank.
widgets.formula: if (loan <= 0 || weeklyInt < 0 || weeks <= 0 || bankRate < 0) return null; var paid = weeklyInt * weeks; var yearly = weeklyInt * 52 / loan * 100; var bank = loan * bankRate / 100 * weeks / 52; return {paid: paid, yearly: Math.round(yearly), bank: Math.round(bank), save: Math.round(paid - bank), level: yearly > 36 ? 'bad' : (yearly > bankRate ? 'warn' : 'good')};

items.title: Self-help group
items.text: SHG loans have low interest and friendly members.
items.te: స్వయం సహాయక సంఘం అప్పులపై వడ్డీ తక్కువ.

items.title: Bank loans
items.text: Banks give small loans with written, fair interest.
items.te: బ్యాంకులు రాతపూర్వక, న్యాయమైన వడ్డీతో అప్పు ఇస్తాయి.

items.title: Save a little first
items.text: Saving ₹20 a day = ₹600 a month for emergencies.

items.title: Ask in writing
items.text: Always ask: 'What is the total I must pay back?'

questions.q: ₹100 interest every week on ₹2,000. How much in one year (52 weeks)?
questions.why: 100 × 52 = ₹5,200. That is more than double the loan!
Bank and SHG rates are usually much lower.

questions.q: What question should you ask before any loan?
questions.why: Knowing the total helps you compare.

how: Collect real examples (no names) of small local loans from elders in the village.
Ask Gemini to convert weekly interest into yearly percentage for each example.
Ask the bank or SHG leader for their usual loan interest rate.
Make a comparison table with Gemini: moneylender vs bank vs SHG.
Design a bar-chart poster in Canva with big numbers and Telugu labels.
Put the poster at the ration shop or Gram Panchayat.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. A worker borrows ₹2,000 and pays ₹100 interest every week. Calculate the total interest in a year and the yearly interest rate. Compare it with a bank or SHG loan at 12% per year. Explain in very simple English and Telugu, and give 4 tips for safer borrowing.
